description: A Python module providing utility functions for path handling, directory and file management, and file content operations, used within a testing or build environment.

methods.name: realpath_with_context
methods.description: Converts a given path to its realpath, using context.workdir for relative paths.

methods.name: posixpath_normpath
methods.description: Normalizes a path and replaces backslashes with slashes to produce a POSIX-style path.

methods.name: ensure_makedirs
methods.description: Creates a directory, retrying up to max_iterations times if needed.

methods.name: read_file_contents
methods.description: Reads and returns the contents of a file, resolving its path with context if provided.

methods.name: create_textfile_with_contents
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a text file with specified contents, ensuring the directory exists.

methods.name: ensure_file_exists
methods.description: Ensures a file exists; creates an empty one if it does not.

methods.name: ensure_directory_exists
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists; creates it if necessary.
